name: Sayed Ahmed Husain
summary:
I am a multidisciplinary engineer bridging the gap between physical infrastructure and digital architecture. With a zero-failure mindset rooted in electrical and fire-life-safety engineering, I bring rigorous discipline to full-stack software development and technical business operations.

**CORE ENGINEERING & COMMERCIAL IMPACT**
• **Project Delivery:** Engineered and commissioned GCC- and NFPA-compliant life-safety systems for major industrial giants (including ALBA and Bahrain Steel), achieving zero safety failures during final inspections.
• **Business Development:** Managed complex vendor pre-qualifications and Bahrain Tender Board bids, directly contributing to over $1M in generated revenue.
• **Operations:** Coordinated cross-functional teams of 15+ technicians, optimizing workflows to reduce commissioning time by 15% and accelerate execution pipelines by 20%.

**SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE & DEVELOPMENT**
Alongside my electrical engineering background, I architect modern, highly concurrent software systems. My technical philosophy centers on deep architectural ownership—I handwrite core framework architecture and logic to ensure peak performance and maintainability.
• **Tech Stack:** Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, REST APIs, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Linux.
• **Selected Projects:** Architected concurrent back-end services (supporting 1,000+ live users with sub-50ms latency), developed a handwritten virtual DOM and reactive state-management framework (PicoJS), and built IoT smart-streetlight systems.

**CREDENTIALS**
I hold a **BSc in Electrical Engineering** from the University of Bahrain and am completing an intensive **Full-Stack Developer** program at Reboot Coding Institute. I am a **CRPEP-licensed** Electrical Engineer, an **EWA Electrical Installation Wireman**, and hold an NOCN Level 3 Award for Solar PV.

*I am currently seeking opportunities where engineering discipline, digital architecture, and commercial awareness intersect to create scalable, dependable solutions.*
